rules.description: A valid water abstraction/discharge licence must be held
rules.remediation: Obtain a discharge licence from the water regulator before any dewatering or discharge; document licence number and expiry.

rules.description: Water discharge monitoring data must be recorded
rules.remediation: Implement a discharge monitoring program with calibrated flow and quality measurements at all discharge points.

rules.description: Total suspended solids in discharge must remain below 50 mg/L
rules.remediation: Install or upgrade sediment control (settling ponds, coagulation) and re-sample discharge until TSS is within limits.

rules.description: Discharge pH must be within the 6.0–9.0 range
rules.remediation: Neutralise acidic or alkaline effluent (lime dosing / acid-rock-drainage treatment) before discharge; investigate ARD sources.

rules.description: A groundwater baseline study must predate operations
rules.remediation: Commission a hydrogeological baseline study with at least 12 months of monitoring bore data.

rules.description: Annual water consumption intensity must be reported
rules.remediation: Meter and report total annual water withdrawal and consumption per tonne of ore processed.
